correctness.rationale: Derive exact two-spectral-level divided-difference derivative; independently maximize symmetric-entry row coefficient absolute sum. Complement coordinates equalize by Cauchy–Schwarz; convexity in the spectral mixing parameter reduces to two endpoint optimizations, with explicit strictly dominating endpoint. The derivative of the rational endpoint has one positive root by Descartes. Explicit sign-valued perturbations approach the bound as the negative gap vanishes. Algebra gives rigorous n=3<2<n=4, strict monotonicity and asymptotic n/4+sqrt(n)/2+3/4. A standalone checker passed 1671 exact and numerical assertions, supplementary to universal proof.

value.rationale: For structured near-singular covariance repair, this establishes an exact, natural local diagonal-entry condition number with extremizing eigenvector pattern and perturbation signs. It proves a meaningful transition at matrix size four and exact linear-in-dimension amplification n/4 despite Hilbert-space nonexpansivity. This is not a routine restatement of the known spectral derivative, and avoids claiming the unknown global optimum.
